svg.title: Qubit cats and ladders
svg.text: One quantum dice roll a day, played on the qubits of IBM's Fez processor (fake_fez calibration data).

svg.text: Every circle is a qubit on the chip; the number is its square in the game
Schrödinger's cat: readout error above 2.0%, back 3
Bridge qubit with every CZ coupler below 1.0% error: a ladder you can climb
Blocked ladder: a cat on the bridge qubit, or a noisy coupler
keep the dice fair (4 today), then 1
